controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HD 50554; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of HD 50554 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of hd-50554's light, as its colour lens measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HD 50554's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 50554 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

physical.credit: Radius from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since HD 50554 b does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Xiao et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Xiao et al. 2023 (2023RAA....23e5022X), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
